jyutping: jat1 ngaan5 zau6 tai2 dak1 ceot1

english.note: Use this when the meaning is that something is immediately obvious from seeing or observing it.

examples.english: You can tell unmistakably at a glance that they are a beginner.
examples.traditional: 一眼就睇得出佢係新手。
examples.jyutping: jat1 ngaan5 zau6 tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 hai6 san1 sau2
